relationships.evidence_quote: ICTF not only up-regulated the levels of CB2 receptor, IL-10, β-endorphin and CD206

relationships.subject: trifluoro-icaritin
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced the expression of P2Y12 receptor, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1, IL-1β, CD11b, and iNOS in the spinal cord of CFA rats

relationships.subject: AM630
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal administration of CB2 receptor antagonist AM630 dramatically reversed the inhibitory effects of ICTF on CFA-induced chronic inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: CB2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: ICTF alleviated CFA-induced neuroinflammation by enhancing CB2 receptor-mediated IL-10/β-endorphin signaling and suppressing microglial activation in the spinal cord

key_findings: ICTF alleviates CFA inflammatory pain via CB2-mediated IL-10/β-endorphin signaling in spinal microglia
CB2 antagonist AM630 reverses ICTF effects and increases P2Y12 and NLRP3
